sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C11923 and card C11923-K2. On December 29, 2016, the customer reported a $131.30 online transaction as unrecognized. Investigation revealed a burst of 19 unauthorized online transactions totaling $1,470.36 on the same day. The flagged transaction was initiated from a new device, identified as D009621 (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | unknown | chrome 66.0 for android | unknown). This device is linked to suspicious activity across three other cards (C05595-K1, C03938-K1, C05678-K1) during the same timeframe, suggesting a coordinated fraud operation. The activity on the compromised card included multiple low-value transactions indicative of card testing, followed by larger purchases. The card has a history of prior compromises, further supporting the conclusion that the card details were stolen and used by an unauthorized third party. The account has been blocked and the transactions declined where possible.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded because the direct customer report and the cross-card device linkage provide decisive probability with two independent pieces of evidence, satisfying policy section 6.
